Check this out - I built a running list of all the Spidey sightings and events. An easy way to make sure you're seeing all the latest updates.

WEB WATCH 1.0
CLOSE
SCORPION

Feels like there's history between Spidey and Scorpion, but I might be reading into it too much. He's got a lethal mechanical tail that you do not want to be stung by.

BOOMERANG

His name is easy to catch; his weapons are not. Boomerang fights by using (surprise, surprise) special boomerangs with different powers.

TARANTULA

Tarantula uses poison-tipped boots as a weapon, so watch those feet. Luckily, Spidey has great reflexes.

THE HAND

Can someone tell me what NINJAS are doing back in New York? The all-red outfits do go kinda hard but feels like it'd be hard to sneak around in.

PUNISHER

Is he a friend of Spider-Man? They've been spotted together but it doesn't always look like they're working as one. Either way, I'd want to stay on his good side (if he has one).

UNKNOWN

There are rumors of a new mysterious villain in the city. Send anything you hear about this, this one's hard to track.
